title: Pure tensor generators with arbitrary finite index types
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $L_i$ be a nonempty finite family of $X$-modules with generating families $σ_i$ [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections], each indexed by an arbitrary finite type $I_i$. Then the free-sheaf map indexed by $∏_i I_i$ sending a tuple to the pure tensor section [def-sc-positive-tensor-family] is an epimorphism. No invertibility or quasi-compactness is assumed.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01AO (tensor generation); Varieties, Tag 09NC (quasi-compact selection)

proof.text: When each I_i is nonempty, enumerate it by ULift (Fin(m_i+1)) and transport its generating map across the induced free-sheaf isomorphism. Apply lem-sc-tensor-generating-sections and reindex its tuple map by the product of these equivalences. When some I_i is empty, its free sheaf is zero and its epimorphic generating map forces L_i to be zero. Tensor with zero is zero, and induction on the left-associated tensor construction shows the whole product is zero. The tuple index type is empty, so its free sheaf is zero too, and the map to the zero tensor product is epi.
